name: Read, explain and save a phrase
description: Check that a reader can open a chapter sentence and save a key phrase directly to chapter notes.
steps: Open A Day in Penang from the bookshelf
Tap the sentence containing get used to
Press the small plus next to get used to
Open or view this chapter notes
expected: The full sentence explanation is shown and get used to appears in the current chapter notes.

name: Review a saved phrase with a retention grade
description: Confirm a saved phrase can be reviewed and its grade is retained.
steps: Open A Day in Penang, tap the sentence containing get used to and save that phrase
Go to 复习
Switch to 词组
Choose 显示释义 and then 掌握
Refresh the page and revisit 复习
expected: The saved phrase remains and a next-review date is shown; no material is lost after refresh.

name: Chapter feedback and learning preferences
description: Record how difficult a chapter felt and change the speech accent preference.
steps: Open a book and tap 完成本章
Select 有些困难, add a learning comment, and save
Go to 设置 and choose British English
Refresh and reopen 设置
expected: The chosen accent remains selected and the learning feedback is stored without changing the book text.

name: Import user material with safe validation
description: Verify the mobile bookshelf and the file import validation prevent unsupported content from causing silent loss.
steps: Open the app on mobile and switch to 书架
Choose 导入 and select a short TXT file with an English sentence
Confirm a new book appears
Attempt to import an invalid JSON file
expected: The TXT material can be opened as a book and invalid JSON presents a visible import failure without removing books.

name: Export personal backup and ensure local-first behavior
description: Ensure the settings area exposes a backup path without any login requirement.
steps: Open 设置 from mobile navigation
Choose 导出备份
Confirm that a JSON download starts
Check that the application never prompts for account creation
expected: A personal JSON backup is downloaded and no account is required for the core features.
